reported.title: No rate limit on fan toggling
reported.description: The sketch has no 5000 ms / 2-transition limiter; a temperature hovering near the 30/26 thresholds can toggle the fan far more than twice per 5 s window.

reported.title: Floating probe not detected
reported.description: A floating A0 reads an arbitrary voltage that may land inside 5–100 °C, so the required force-ON safe state is never entered; there is no open-circuit/rail detection.

reported.title: Fault force-ON latency too slow
reported.description: Fault must force fan ON within 600 ms, but faultHold requires HOLD_N=4 ticks at 50 ms plus loop jitter; combined with the missing floating detection the 600 ms deadline is not reliably met.

reported.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V Vcc
reported.description: readTempC uses 5000/1023 mV per count; with the default AVcc reference this mis-scales temperature if Vcc differs from 5.000 V, shifting the 30/26 °C trip points.

reported.title: Status print uses stale temp on first tick
reported.description: printStatus can run before the first 50 ms tick has populated tempC, printing 0.0 C on the first status line.

judge_input.spec:
- Air temperature probe on A0 at 10 mV/°C; potting-shed vent fan on D6.
- Open the fan at 30.0 °C or above; close the fan at 26.0 °C or below.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- If the probe is floating, or temperature reads below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, force the fan ON within 600 ms and hold that safe state for the duration of the fault.
- Print `shed: <temp> C fan=ON` or `shed: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
